verdict.rationale: DPMA's online register and search services could plausibly offer event-triggered automation, such as watch rules that send alerts when a register entry changes, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers database search (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister), e-filing routes (DPMAdirektWeb/Pro, ePCT) and procedural rules. Nothing shows user-defined rules that trigger actions automatically on events, so absence of evidence yields none.
